func_8020F170_66E120.title: Create the standard Japan-map task
func_8020F170_66E120.summary: Standard file_17 Japan-map constructor and lifecycle boundary.
behavior: Direct US-ROM disassembly establishes seven arguments: parent, mode, marker-context word, character, source room, world X, and world Z. The return register carries the allocated outer task or zero on failure.
The routine creates its inner marker task through func_8020E930_66D8E0 and maps the source room and coordinates through func_8020F734_66E6E4.
cautions: Overlay identity is required because 0x8020F170 is reused outside file_17.
The marker-context word is stored and forwarded, but its broader gameplay meaning remains unresolved.

func_8020F3B8_66E368.title: Create a fixed-location Japan-map task
func_8020F3B8_66E368.summary: Separate file_17 constructor for two fixed native map sequences.
behavior: Direct US-ROM disassembly establishes the parent and mode arguments and a task-pointer return.
Mode 0 initializes room 0x0138 and world position (-120.0, -300.0); mode 1 initializes room 0x0177 and (0.0, 0.0). Both feed the common room mapper and marker constructor.
cautions: Only modes 0 and 1 have complete native field initialization in the inspected branches.
This constructor is distinct from the ordinary func_8020F170_66E120 path.

func_8020E630_66D5E0.title: Update Japan-map markers
func_8020E630_66D5E0.summary: Persistent update callback for the common file_17 marker task.
behavior: func_8020E930_66D8E0 installs this callback on the inner marker task. The native body reads the task from a0 and does not consume a1.

The phase counter at task offset 0xA4 reaches its toggle path every 21 calls. When the byte at 0xB0 is zero, the routine XORs bit 0 at object offset 0x64 for the face at task+0x5C and 15 nullable destination-marker pointers through task+0x98.
cautions: The pointer block and counters are version-specific native task layout, not a general actor ABI.
Entry and return hooks observe opposite sides of the native phase update.

evidence.note: Entry hook captures the exact marker task used to attach additional engine-owned records.

Return hook leaves the stock local face untouched while forcing active remote records visible and inactive retained records hidden; current file SHA-256 23039504585884ba600ccc1821f8c58db540ffece8d33fc27da64678c6337c13.

func_8020F734_66E6E4.title: Map a room position onto Japan
func_8020F734_66E6E4.summary: file_17 room and world-coordinate mapper for the Japan map's 49 canonical XYZ positions.
behavior: Direct US-ROM disassembly establishes the unsigned room, two float inputs, three output pointers, and void return ABI.

The room jump table covers 0x012C through 0x017D. Branches choose coordinate indices 0 through 48, with several room-specific world-X/Z splits, then copy all three floats from D_FLT_80216BF0 to the caller outputs.
Out-of-range rooms select coordinate index 0 rather than returning a failure indication.
cautions: The routine does not check any output pointer before writing.
Coordinate index 0 is also a legitimate result for some in-range branches and cannot serve as a validity sentinel.
